summary: Document fresh roster trace attributes and cover exactly-once page recording

schema.detail: No schema, claims, storage version or response field changes.

rules.detail: The same page selection, rendering and wait policy apply. A single telemetry recording point also covers failed page rendering, which cannot verify a served publication.

compatibility.detail: Documents additive attributes on the existing request span; the parent change declares their compatibility impact.

downtime.detail: No performance claim; proof work under churn is authored as a native measurement control and remains unmeasured.
